captions.caption: A person in gloves uses a speed square to mark a wooden plank.
The person uses a pencil to draw a line along the speed square on the wood.
A close-up shows the speed square positioned on the edge of the wooden board.
The person adjusts the speed square's position on the wooden plank.
The person draws another mark on the wood using the speed square as a guide.
The person continues marking the wood with a pencil and speed square.
The person finishes drawing a line on the wooden plank.
The person prepares the wood for a cut, showing the marked lines.
The person uses the speed square to check the angle on the wood.
The person marks a diagonal line on the wooden board.
The person completes the marking process on the wooden plank.
A close-up view of the markings on the wooden board is shown.
The person prepares to move the wood to the saw.
The person makes a final check of the markings on the wood.
The person positions the wood on the miter saw for cutting.
A miter saw is used to cut through the marked wooden plank.
The saw blade cuts through the wood, creating wood dust.
The cut is completed, and the saw blade is lifted.
The freshly cut piece of wood is shown on the saw's surface.
Two men on ladders begin working on the roof of a structure.
They lift a long wooden beam towards the metal roof frame.
The men position the wooden beam against the roof structure.
They continue to align the beam with the edge of the roof.
The men hold the beam in place while preparing to secure it.
They adjust the beam's position to ensure it is level.
One man starts to secure the beam to the roof frame with a drill.
The man uses a power drill to drive a screw into the wood and metal.
The men continue working together to install the wooden beam.
They move along the roof to secure the next part of the beam.
The men are focused on attaching the beam to the metal truss.
One man drills another screw into the beam to keep it in place.
The men ensure the beam is firmly attached to the roof structure.
They continue the installation process on the roof.
One man uses his drill while the other provides support.
The men work on the far end of the wooden beam.
They are seen from a low angle, working high up on the structure.
The installation of the first beam is nearly complete.
One man begins to descend his ladder after finishing his task.
Both men move their ladders to a new position on the roof.
They prepare to install the next piece of the roof structure.
The men are now working on the corner of the roof.
They position a new wooden beam at the corner of the structure.
The men work together to align the corner beam correctly.
They hold the beam in place against the roof frame.
One man prepares his drill to secure the corner beam.
They are working near a large tree next to the structure.
The man on the ladder drills a screw into the corner beam.
He continues to secure the beam to the roof frame.
The other man watches and assists from the ground.
The man on the ladder moves to a different spot on the roof.
They discuss the placement of the next component.
The man on the ground hands a tool to the man on the ladder.
The man on the ladder starts working on another part of the roof.
He is seen working on the roof structure from a low angle.
He reaches up to adjust a piece of the roof frame.
The man continues his work on the roof installation.
He uses a tool to secure a component to the roof.
The man on the ground observes the work being done.
The man on the ladder finishes securing the roof section.
The men prepare for the next stage of the construction.
